sources.snippet: IndexTTS is a zero-shot text-to-speech system that clones a voice from a single reference audio clip. The latest release, IndexTTS-2.5, supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Spanish and Arabic, with fine-grained emotion control, speaking speed control, pronunciation control (Pinyin / CMU phonemes / Japanese Kana), and faster inference than IndexTTS-2.

sources.title: ling0322/libwaifu-illustrious-xl-v2.0 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Illustrious XL v2.0-STABLE for libwaifu Illustrious XL v2.0-STABLE converted to the format libwaifu reads, so it can draw from it directly. The weights are the original ones: the U-Net and both text encoders are stored as float16, and the VAE is left wider because it overflows float16.
